entries.title: Attach files to emails, Email Campaigns and email templates
entries.summary: Emails can now carry attachments. Add up to five files — PDFs, Office documents, images, CSV, text or calendar invites, 10 MB each and 15 MB per email — when you **Send Email** from Contacts, Speakers or any module, in step 2 of an Email Campaign, and on organization and event email templates. Picking a template brings its files with it. Every file is checked by its contents: macros, PDFs that launch or carry programs, archives and programs are refused with the reason shown next to the file.

where.path: Send Email composer (any module or the CRM) → Attachments; Email Campaigns → New campaign → Basic info → Attachments; Settings → Email Templates → template → Attachments

entries.use_case: A program team sends accepted speakers their presenter guide and the slide template with the acceptance email, instead of a link to the portal that half of them never open. A recurring speaker-reminder campaign carries the same AV checklist every time because it lives on the template.

internal.when_to_bring_up: A customer asks how to attach a PDF, slide template or calendar invite to a bulk email or campaign, or is pasting portal links into every email as a workaround.
internal.who_should_get_it: Every customer that emails speakers or contacts from Sessionboard.
internal.staff_path: Any module → select records → Send Email → Attachments; Email Campaigns → Basic info → Attachments; Settings → Email Templates
internal.gotchas: Limits are 5 files, 10 MB each, 15 MB per email. Files are checked by contents, not extension: a macro-enabled .xlsm, a PDF with a launch action or an attached .exe, a .zip, or a renamed file is refused at upload. Built-in lifecycle templates (Accept, Decline, reminders) do not take attachments. If a file is removed from storage after a send is queued, that email fails in History instead of going out without it. Attachments lock with the subject and body once a campaign starts sending.
internal.talk_track: Attach the presenter guide or slide template right on the email — or on the template, so every send has it. Sessionboard checks every file before it goes out, so nothing with macros or hidden programs lands in a speaker's inbox from you.
